acceptance_criteria: `swx-core`: `FeatureKind::ImportedSolid { attachment: String, sha256: String }`. It reports no inputs and no parameters, and editing an unrelated parameter does not mark it dirty (spec §6 test 4).

`swx-io`: `Document` gains `attachments: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>`, read and written under `attachments/` in both the unpacked folder and the `.sltwx` ZIP, names in sorted order. A 3-byte and a 100 KB attachment round-trip byte for byte through `write_unpacked`/`read_unpacked` and `write_sltwx`/`read_sltwx` (test 1). Existing golden files are still reproduced byte for byte.

`model.json` reads and writes `import_step` feature entries with `source.attachment`, `source.sha256`, `source.original_name` as in spec §1; write → read gives the same fields and a second write is byte-identical (test 2).

`embed_step(doc, path)` and `rebuild_imported(kernel, doc, id)` behave as spec §1–§3 say. Without OCCT, a missing attachment, a SHA-256 mismatch (one byte flipped) and a file without the `ISO-10303-21;` header each give the exact message from spec §3 (test 3).

With `--features occt`, round trip (test 5): a 40 × 25 × 10 mm box, `export_step`, `embed_step`, `write_sltwx`, `read_sltwx`, `rebuild_imported` gives volume 10 000 mm³ and bounding box (0, 0, 0)–(40, 25, 10), both within 1e-6 relative; the embedded bytes equal the exported file and `source.sha256` matches them. Same through the unpacked form.

With `--features occt`, units (test 6): replacing `SI_UNIT(.MILLI.,.METRE.)` with `SI_UNIT($,.METRE.)` in the exported text gives a 40 000 × 25 000 × 10 000 mm box, volume 1e13 mm³ within 1e-6 relative. (The spec's §4 calls this "test 3"; it is test 6.)
With `--features occt`, a file with a valid header and a truncated body gives `STEP import of … failed: …` at import and adds nothing to the document (test 7).
`Kernel::import_step` gets a doc comment on unit conversion citing ISO 10303-41 and the OCCT STEP translator guide (`xstep.cascade.unit`), as spec §4 says.
One appended ADR line in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` records the `swx-io → swx-kernel` path dependency and its `occt` feature (skip if #216 already added it). No new third-party dependency.
All existing tests pass unchanged; no test is weakened or removed.

`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and `cargo clippy -p swx-io --features occt --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p swx-io --features occt` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
